## Specific task description

Task instruction: Collect the plastic bottle with two distinct parts, the bottle with blue highlights, and the medium black bottle inside the left-side the curved rectangular trash can.

Task description: Put the plastic bottle with a red cap, distinct light shoulder, and dark body, the clear bottle with blue accents, and the black bottle with an orange-yellow label at the rear right into the white rounded rectangular bin on the left of the table.

Success criteria: All three target bottles must enter the interior of the left bin at a height below the table but some distance above the floor. Merely moving them above the opening or dropping them onto the floor is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Prefer a straight section of the bottle body below the shoulder, with a diameter suitable for the gripper, so the pads make full contact on both sides. Avoid the cap, sloped shoulder, and base edge as much as possible to reduce slipping or an off-center grasp.
- Set the gripper opening slightly wider than the selected grasp section and use the side view to confirm the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the bottle. Avoid closing based only on image overlap and pushing it over.
- The blue bottle is near a tall yellow bottle behind, while the right target is near a gray box and tool. Approach from the side with more space and orient in open space to reduce collisions.
- During transport, give the bottle bottom enough height to clear the table and bin rims. At release, place the entire horizontal footprint inside the bin opening, lower the release height without the fingers hitting the rim, and avoid bottles already inside to reduce rim impacts, rebounds, or perching on the edge.
